explanation: The AI assistant incorrectly identified the scholar who theorized pulmonary circulation as William Harvey (who described full systemic circulation, though Ibn al-Nafis first theorized pulmonary circulation in 1213–1288, or Michael Servetus). Thus, the lifespan dates provided (1578–1657) are incorrect.
